Returned Clawback  Excess carried interest paid to the investment adviser or any of its related persons, including amounts held in escrow, which has been returned to the private fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Offering/Syndication Costs  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2]. Offering/Syndication Costs  Fees/costs incurred to market or sell an interest in the private fund. These fees might not be recorded as an income statement line-item in a private fund’s financial records, but rather a direct reduction to partners’ capital [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Management Fees – Net of Offsets, Waivers & Rebates  Periodic gross management fees, less any offsets, fee waivers and fee rebates (applied during the period) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Management Fees – Gross of Offsets, Waivers & Rebates  Periodic gross management fees, prior to any application of offsets, fee waivers and fee rebates (applied during the period) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

(Partnership Expenses – Bank Fees)  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Partnership Expenses – External [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2]. Partnership Expenses – Bank Fees  Fees/expenses allocated to or paid by the private fund for banking services. Excludes custody fees or third-party expenses for fund administration and accounting. Excludes fees/expenses for interest and fees/interest related to credit facilities and other short-term financing at the fund level [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Carried Interest Accrued (Unrealized Profits)  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Investment Income [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2]. Carried Interest Accrued (Unrealized Profits)  Periodic change in the investment adviser's or any of its related persons' share of any unrealized profits from portfolio investments (a.k.a. Incentive Allocation or GP Profit Share). The calculation assumes that all investments are realized at their fair market value at the quarter-end date [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Unapplied Offset Balance (Roll-forward) – Beginning Balance  Prior period, ending-balance for any fees/expenses, subject to offset against the private fund's fees/expenses, that have been recognized, but not yet credited to the benefit of the private fund's investors [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Unapplied Offset Balance (Roll-forward) – Ending Balance  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Partnership Expenses – External (calculated row) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Dividend Income  Dividend income received by the private fund from portfolio investments [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Dividend Income  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Investment Income [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Broken Deal Fee Offset  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Partnership Expenses – External [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2]. Broken Deal Fees  Termination fees/expenses received from counterparties of the private fund's unconsummated deals, netted against any termination fees/expenses paid to counterparties that weren't reimbursed by the private fund (include any fees not subject to offset) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Total Reimbursements for Travel & Administrative Expenses  Repayment of any travel or other administrative expenses from the Fund's portfolio investment to the investment adviser or any of its related persons [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Total Reimbursements for Travel & Administrative Expenses****  B.1 With Respect to the Private Fund's Portfolio Companies/Investments [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Interest Income  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Investment Income [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2]. Interest Income  Net interest income (expense) received by the private fund from portfolio investments. Includes interest income earned through bridge financing, regardless of source (i.e., equity, debt, Subscription Facility). Also includes deal-level interest expenses that flow through to the private fund and are ultimately charged to the private fund's investors [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Other Fee Offsets: 2016 ILPA Reporting Template Value  Introduced to allow GPs to report offsets previously classified in a more rolled-up fashion in the 2016 ILPA Reporting Template dating back to the inception of the private fund, without requiring a reclassification of the offsets. Other Fees: 2016 ILPA Reporting Template Value  Introduced to allow GPs to report fees previously classified in a more rolled-up fashion in the 2016 ILPA Reporting Template that were allocated or paid to the investment adviser or any of its related persons dating back to the inception of the private fund, without requiring a reclassification of the fees. For Funds launched Q1 2026 or later, this field should not be used [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Expenses – Allocated/Paid to Investment Adviser or Related Persons - Net of Offsets  Periodic gross fees/expenses that are allocated or paid to the investment adviser or any of its related persons by the private fund for work performed by internal staff/related persons, less any offsets (applied during the period) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. External Partnership Expenses – Net of Offsets, Waivers & Rebates  Periodic gross partnership expenses allocated to or paid by the private fund during, less any offsets, fee waivers and fee rebates (applied during the period). GP's Allocation of Total Fund  Balances that represent the equity interest, including carried interest, in the fund of the investment adviser, or any of its related persons, that manage or exert control over the private fund, including the General Partner or Managing Member [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Carried Interest – Paid During the Period  The investment adviser's or any of its related persons' share of any realized profits from a portfolio investment (a.k.a. Incentive Allocation or GP Profit Share) that have been collected by the investment adviser or any of its related persons [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Returned Clawback  Excess carried interest paid to the investment adviser or any of its related persons, including amounts held in escrow, which has been returned to the private fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Column groups  LP #5's Allocation of Total Fund / Cumulative LPs' Allocation of Total Fund / Affiliated Positions*** [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

With Respect to the Fund's Portfolio Companies/Investments  Fees, expenses and reimbursements paid/accrued by (or in regards to) the Fund's portfolio holdings to the investment adviser and any of its related persons; Include any fees received from third-parties regarding arrangements for the investment (i.e., purchasing discount fees), and any fees received after the liquidation of the Fund or any sleeve/AIV of the Fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. ***Balances in this section represent fees & reimbursements received by the Investment Adviser & Related Persons with respect to the Fund's investments that are not allocable to the Total Fund (i.e., allocated to ownership interests of LP co-investors & other vehicles managed-by/affiliated-with the Investment Adviser/Related Person); To avoid double-counting, LP # 5's Allocation of Total Fund should not reflect any pro-rata share of these positions; Balances in this section, plus the balances in the "Cumulative LPs' Allocation of Total Fund" section, should equal the total fees/reimbursements received by the Investment Adviser & Related Persons With Respect to the Fund's Portfolio Companies/Investments [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

LP's Allocation of Total Fund  Balances that represent the single investor's interest in the total private fund. Estimations are acceptable for any single investor amount that's denoted with a "****" [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Column groups  LP #5's Allocation of Total Fund / Total Fund (incl. GP Allocation) / GP's Allocation of Total Fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].
